subject: Orchid Health — private deployment: operational audit window & access request
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@orchidhealth.com>
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@orchidhealth.com>, legal@orchidhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Private deployment questions + SOW redline

Hi Dev — thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the session with Security & Ops and we have two asks for the private (VPC-hosted) deployment that are out of the standard SOW: 1) data residency/retention: all customer PHI for EU patients must stay in EU regions and be retained for 7 years per our compliance team; 2) audit rights: Orchid requires an annual on-site or remote audit window of up to 30 consecutive days with the ability to pull raw logs and request screened host access for troubleshooting.

We prefer a DocuSign-friendly addendum; I attached our redlined SOW (Orchid_SOW_redline_v3.pdf) and a simplified network diagram. Pricing and discount will factor into procurement — can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the 30-day audit window and the host access carveout? If not, what mitigations would you propose?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call.

—
Emma Zhao
Head of Security Programs
Orchid Health
emma.zhao@orchidhealth.com
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@orchidhealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-15T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment questions + SOW redline

Emma — thanks for the redline and the clear scope. Quick summary on what we can do and where we need exceptions: 

- Data residency: we can provision a dedicated VPC in the EU region and ensure data-at-rest keys are EU KMS-backed; retention policies can be set to 7 years for customer PHI — will require a configuration addendum.
- Audit window: our standard private SOW permits an annual audit with up to a 14-day remote window and logs export (redacted where necessary). A 30-day window with host-level access is non-standard because of security posture and support capacity.
- Host access: we do support jumpbox-based, timeboxed, session-recorded troubleshooting sessions for named personnel (read-only where possible). Full SSH to hosts and raw disk access requires legal review and operational controls.

Attachments: I pulled in the redline and added commentary (see Orchid_SOW_redline_v3.pdf). If Orchid needs a longer audit period we can propose compensating controls: pre-scheduled audit windows, escrowed logs, scoped on-site presence with signed NDA and limited to specific services.

I'm looping Marissa (sales lead) to surface to Deal Desk for pricing and to coordinate an executive approval path if Orchid insists on 30 days + host access. Would you be open to a 21-day compromise and a technical control set (jumpbox + session recording + logs escrow)?

Best,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-16T14:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment questions + SOW redline

Emma / Dev — appreciate the quick back-and-forth. Commercial note: Orchid is an enterprise opportunity with strong ARR potential; they are asking for a material concession on audit exposure and an aggressive discount to move from a pilot to a 3-year committed deployment.

Deal Desk proposal (pending leadership): we can consider a one-time concession to extend the audit window to 21 days (from our standard 14) if Orchid accepts the following mitigations: 
- single annual audit event limited to 21 consecutive days
- jumpbox-only, session-recorded troubleshooting for named engineers (no unmonitored SSH)
- log escrow with cryptographic hash proofs, retained for the audit period + 30 days
- SOC 2 evidence sharing and quarterly integrity scans

In commercial terms, pricing impact: I can support up to an 18% discount off published private rates contingent on a signed addendum that binds the mitigations above. Anything beyond 21 days or host-level access requires executive sign-off (legal flagged host access as > risk tolerance). Dev — can you escalate to VP/EM/Legal for exec approval on the 21-day concession + 18% discount? If leadership signs off we will incorporate a bespoke addendum and push to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-17T08:47:00Z
Subject: Escalation: Orchid Health — request for 21-day audit window + discount approval (ORD-4721)

Lauren — quick escalation and ask. Orchid Health (prospect) is asking for a private VPC deployment in EU with two non-standard asks: a 21–30 day audit window and limited host access during audits. Deal Desk (Marissa) recommends we can concede to 21 days plus the following operational constraints, but needs leadership approval for the concession and discount (18% proposed). I summarize below and include prior thread for context.

Risk assessment: 
- 21-day audit window increases exposure surface for support interactions and escalates personnel time (on-call rotations).
- Host-level access is the highest risk item; however, jumpbox-only with session recording and naming/approval of engineers substantially reduces risk. 

Proposed approval (recommended): 
1) Approve a one-time contract addendum allowing a single annual 21-day audit window (not more frequent) with remote-first approach.
2) Allow timeboxed jumpbox sessions for named Orchid engineers plus Redwood-observed troubleshooting sessions; no unmonitored SSH or raw disk extraction.
3) Mandatory log escrow: Redwood will export cryptographically hashed logs and make them available to Orchid during the audit window; Redwood retains copy for 30 days post-audit.
4) Commercial concession: approve a maximum 15% discount to private published rates (Marissa proposed 18% but I recommend 15% given operational cost).

Conditions (must be in addendum): 
- Pre-scheduled audit dates with 30 days' notice for onboarding the Redwood support rotation.
- Legal-approved NDA for any on-site personnel.
- Redwood reserves right to deny access that would compromise multi-tenant isolation or require code-level debugging that risks other customers.

Please advise: approve as-is (I will draft the addendum), approve with a different discount cap, or reject and we will propose an alternative (14 days remote only + 10% discount).

Quoted previous message: 
> Marissa: "In commercial terms, pricing impact: I can support up to an 18% discount ..."

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute sync to walk through mitigations.

—
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Architect
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-18T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: Orchid Health — request for 21-day audit window + discount approval (ORD-4721)

Team — reviewed. I approve the concession with the following binding conditions (legal to draft the addendum):

1) Audit window: one annual audit event up to 21 consecutive days; any extension requires VP-level re-approval.
2) Access model: only jumpbox-based sessions for named and pre-approved Orchid personnel; all sessions must be recorded, monitored by Redwood staff, and limited to read-only unless a jointly-agreed troubleshooting script is executed with mutual sign-off. No raw disk mounts or arbitrary root access.
3) Log escrow: provide an export of requested logs with SHA-256 hashes; Redwood retains a sealed copy for 30 days after the audit window.
4) Security equivalence: Orchid must accept the SOC 2 evidence package and agree to quarterly integrity scans as a contractual obligation.
5) Commercial concession: approve a maximum 15% discount off private list pricing for this three-year commitment. Any deeper concession requires CFO/CEO sign-off.

Action items: Legal — draft addendum with the clauses above and prepare DocuSign link. Marissa — update opportunity in HubSpot and change deal stage to Contract Sent. Dev — once addendum is ready, schedule a technical pre-audit walkthrough with Orchid.

Approved by:
Lauren Bishop
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
